History of WOAY Careers at WOAY Search Share FacebookTwitterPrintEmailPinterestReddItViber Beckley, WV (WOAY) Mark your calendars for May 2. Fitzpatrick Park will host the “Guns N’ Hoses” Benefit Softball Tournament, where local police and fire departments will go head-to-head. Community members can also get in on the action by registering for the Public Banana Ball Tournament. Proceeds will benefit charities selected by participating teams. Organizers say space is limited, so early registration is encouraged. For more information, you can contact Nathan James at 304-923-5178.
